browserConsoleErrors: Expected PouchDB checkpoint 404 responses during initial replication.
Expected image/network failures after Playwright explicitly disabled networking.
toolingGaps: flow-app-progress does not recursively index client actions nested under iterator event scopes and therefore reports three false unknown-action warnings.
Adding views to an existing scaffold does not immediately update the CouchDB design document; schema learning returned missing_named_view until established views were reused.
A dynamic object sent through a project Flow block was serialized as a literal value; direct requestable.call was required for marker documents.
Large list.map seeds produce 11,540 to 13,020 trace nodes and take tens of seconds per 768 to 1,000 documents.
Several large MCP responses failed JSON-RPC deserialization, and deep frontend/browser inspection produced excessive response volume.

workflowCorrection.reason: The initial UI exposed all diagnostic stages and required a manual root query; it did not implement the RetailStore browsing workflow.
behavior: Initialization and synchronization automatically open the root catalog.
Root, level 2, level 3, products and detail are mutually exclusive stages.
Back controls restore the previous stage without repeating a server request.
All repeated catalog stages use responsive grids.
Category and product images use portable project resources.
A second complete branch remains browsable after networking is disabled.

postRunFixes: Allowed read-only FullSync access to design documents in Convertigo develop.
Assigned backend call configurations by client action id so repeated requestables retain distinct variables.
Regenerated and redeployed the application with offsets 0, 1000 and 2000.
Added schema-backed client state actions and conditional bindings.
Rebuilt the catalog as a five-stage RetailStore workflow with automatic root loading and Back navigation.
Replaced broken inherited image URLs with portable project assets.
